description: The square-root search returns at most \(x\) exactly when \(x\) is a square; it returns the unique root if there is one, and otherwise returns \(x+1\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.squareRootSearch_spec (x : ℕ) :
  (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.squareRootSearch x ≤ x ↔ ∃ i, i * i = x) ∧
    (∀ (i : ℕ), i * i = x → Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.squareRootSearch x = i) ∧
      (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.squareRootSearch x = x + 1 ↔ ¬∃ i, i * i = x)
